entries.title: I Samuel 3:1
segments: ¶Then the boy Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was rare in those days; [there was] no widespread revelation.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:2
segments: And it came to pass at that time, while Eli [was] lying down in his place, and when his eyes had begun to grow so dim that he could not see,

entries.title: I Samuel 3:3
segments: and before the lamp of God went out in the tabernacle of the LORD where the ark of God [was], and while Samuel was lying down,

entries.title: I Samuel 3:4
segments: that the LORD called Samuel. And he answered, "Here I am!"

entries.title: I Samuel 3:5
segments: So he ran to Eli and said, "Here I am, for you called me." And he said, "I did not call; lie down again." And he went and lay down.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:6
segments: Then the LORD called yet again, "Samuel!" So Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, "Here I am, for you called me." He answered, "I did not call, my son; lie down again."

entries.title: I Samuel 3:7
segments: (Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, nor was the word of the LORD yet revealed to him.)

entries.title: I Samuel 3:8
segments: And the LORD called Samuel again the third time. Then he arose and went to Eli, and said, "Here I am, for you did call me." Then Eli perceived that the LORD had called the boy.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:9
segments: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, "Go, lie down; and it shall be, if He calls you, that you must say, 'Speak, LORD, for Your servant hears.'" So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:10
segments: Now the LORD came and stood and called as at other times, "Samuel! Samuel!" And Samuel answered, "Speak, for Your servant hears."

entries.title: I Samuel 3:11
segments: ¶Then the LORD said to Samuel: "Behold, I will do something in Israel at which both ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:12
segments: "In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from beginning to end.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:13
segments: "For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knows, because his sons made themselves vile, and he did not restrain them.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:14
segments: "And therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be atoned for by sacrifice or offering forever."

entries.title: I Samuel 3:15
segments: So Samuel lay down until morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel was afraid to tell Eli the vision.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:16
segments: Then Eli called Samuel and said, "Samuel, my son!" And he answered, "Here I am."

entries.title: I Samuel 3:17
segments: And he said, "What [is] the word that [the LORD] spoke to you? Please do not hide [it] from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that He said to you."

entries.title: I Samuel 3:18
segments: Then Samuel told him everything, and hid nothing from him. And he said, "It [is] the LORD. Let Him do what seems good to Him."

entries.title: I Samuel 3:19
segments: ¶So Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:20
segments: And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel [had been] established as a prophet of the LORD.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:21
segments: Then the LORD appeared again in Shiloh. For the LORD revealed Himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD.
